questions.stem: What is the escape velocity from Earth's surface?
questions.explanation: The escape velocity from Earth's surface is approximately 11.2 km/s. This is the minimum speed an object must reach to escape Earth's gravitational field without any further propulsion.

questions.stem: Kepler's third law states that for orbiting bodies, the square of the orbital period is proportional to:

options.text: The square of the radius of the orbit
The cube of the radius of the orbit
The mass of the orbiting body

questions.explanation: Kepler's third law states that T² is proportional to r³, meaning the square of the orbital period is proportional to the cube of the orbital radius. This relationship applies to all objects orbiting the same central body.
